argv:
SELECT i.id, l.label FROM issues i JOIN labels l ON l.issue_id = i.id AND l.label LIKE 'project:%'
  WHERE i.status = 'open' AND i.is_blocked = 0 AND NOT (i.issue_type = 'decision' OR COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.metadata, '$.kind')), '') = 'captain' OR LOCATE('[design-ux]', i.title) > 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM labels cl WHERE cl.issue_id = i.id AND cl.label = 'design-ux')) AND i.ephemeral = 0
    AND (i.defer_until IS NULL OR i.defer_until <= NOW())
    AND COALESCE(i.assignee, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.metadata, '$.hold_reason')), '') = ''
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d JOIN issues c ON c.id = d.depends_on_issue_id
      WHERE d.issue_id = i.id AND d.type <> 'tracks' AND c.status <> 'closed'
        AND (c.issue_type = 'decision' OR COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.metadata, '$.kind')), '') = 'captain' OR LOCATE('[design-ux]', c.title) > 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM labels cl WHERE cl.issue_id = c.id AND cl.label = 'design-ux')))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d JOIN issues c ON c.id = d.issue_id
      WHERE d.depends_on_issue_id = i.id AND d.type <> 'tracks' AND c.status <> 'closed'
        AND (c.issue_type = 'decision' OR COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.metadata, '$.kind')), '') = 'captain' OR LOCATE('[design-ux]', c.title) > 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM labels cl WHERE cl.issue_id = c.id AND cl.label = 'design-ux')))
  ORDER BY i.priority, i.created_at, i.id, l.label
